conviction_note: The evidence is balanced. The volume and share line, which is where this name's last sold print turned, leans negative: Q3 peers took share and the FY volume guide is under pressure. Profit and pricing lean positive: peers' Q3 profit grew 28-79% against a ZTO consensus implying about +10% adjusted net income. The stock is de-rated (down about 14% since late July, 10% above its 52-week low). impact_sum is +0.05, the scaled number is -0.22 (p_up 48 x abs 5.5), and the two agree that there is no edge here.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS: CN¥3.43 per ADS (Chartmill, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/ZTO/estimates) and US$0.48 (TipRanks 0A33 line). These two roughly agree at about RMB7.1/USD. The iTiger preview of 2026-11-11 (https://www.itiger.com/news/1166584363) instead carries adj EPS 3.10 (+31% YoY), revenue RMB13.44bn (+13.9%) and EBIT RMB2.97bn. Chartmill revenue is RMB13.79bn. Q3 2025 base (company release, https://www.barchart.com/story/news/36217192/zto-reports-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results): revenue RMB11,864.7m, adj NI RMB2,506.1m, volume 9,573m. The company guides only volume: FY2026 40.8-42.4bn parcels, +6-10% (Q2 release, 2026-08-18). The EPS bar is partly disputed, so the profit finding is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest about 14.6M ADS at the 2026-07-15 FINRA settlement, roughly 11.4 days to cover, up from 9.8 at 06-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/zto/short-interest/). MarketBeat had 15.37M and 6.9 days at 2026-03-31. That is about 2% of shares, so not crowded by share count, but days-to-cover is high because ADS turnover is thin (20d avg 1.74M). No November figure was found. Skew: skew_25d_vol_points is null in the baseline. Put/call OI is 0.98 and total OI only 883, with a 50% ATM spread, so the 4.67% event-implied move is indicative only. Tape: spot 20.72, run-up +2.47% over 20d, 19.9% below the 52-week high, 9.9% above the low, realised vol 16.9%. The stock was $24.00 on 2026-07-27 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/zto-express-cayman-inc-nysezto-given-consensus-recommendation-of-buy-by-brokerages-2026-07-27/), so it has de-rated about 14% through the Q2 volume-guide cut.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 industry volume grew 3.0% to 50.91bn while ZTO's peers grew far faster: STO +17.6% (includes Danniao, consolidated Nov 2025), J&T China +15.3% (up from +9.6% in H1), YTO +12.4%; Yunda -0.1%, SF -6.6%. ZTO's own Q2 growth was +6.5% at 19.9% share (Q3 2025 share about 19.4%). Peers absorbed more than the industry's whole increment, so ZTO's Q3 volume growth most likely decelerated to low single digits (about 2-5%) with flat or lower share. On the FY guide (40.8-42.4bn, +6-10%; H1 was 20.15bn), the low end needs only H2 +2.7%, but the midpoint needs about +6.3%. A narrowing toward the low end, or a fourth volume-guide cut in five reports, is the likely outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ZTO has cut its volume guide in Q2 2025 (-5.78% after hours, https://www.itiger.com/news/1177698845), in Q3 2025 (to 12.3-13.8%) and in Q2 2026 (from 10-13% to 6-10%; shares fell despite adj NI +50%, https://www.ainvest.com/news/zto-sold-guidance-cut-quarter-proves-price-war-2608/). The Q4 2025 print, with a 10-13% guide and a $1.5bn buyback, rose about 9% (https://www.itiger.com/news/2620825450). On this name the volume/share line has outweighed the profit line.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer Q3 volumes have been public since 15-26 October and the stock is already 14% below late July, so part of this is in the price. The previews (iTiger 11-11) still frame the quarter as EBIT growth and say nothing about share. If the market had fully priced a share loss and a further guide trim, the stock would be at or below its 52-week low rather than 10% above it, and sell-side previews would carry a Q3 volume number below Q2's +6.5%.
findings.independence: Same Huachuang note for the industry figure. Independent peer sources: STO Q3 volume 7.661bn, +17.6% (https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261026/c681060665.shtml, 2026-10-26); J&T China 6.43bn, +15.3% (https://technode.global/2026/10/15/2026-10-15-jt-express-q3-parcel-volume/, 2026-10-15); YTO Q3 8.682bn, +12.45% (https://wap.eastmoney.com/a/202610213902797224.html, 2026-10-21). ZTO's Q2 baseline is from its own release (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/zto-express-cayman-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-18/). Inference: ZTO's Q3 volume is not disclosed by anyone.

findings.finding: Peer Q3 2026 profits were strong under anti-involution pricing: YTO attributable NI RMB1.454bn (+39.1%), STO RMB0.54bn (+78.7%), Yunda RMB0.26bn (+28.3%), SF +5.5%. Industry Q3 revenue grew 6.8% against volume +3.0%, about +3.7% per piece. ZTO's consensus implies adj NI of only about +10-11% YoY (CN¥3.43 per ADS x about 810M diluted ADS is about RMB2.78bn, against RMB2.506bn in Q3 2025), close to its own Q2 run-rate ex-items (Q2 adj NI RMB3,086m, +50.3%, core ASP +15.5%). Peers' ASP softened quarter on quarter (YTO Q3 2.06 vs H1 2.13; STO Q3 2.12 vs YTD 2.20), so the most likely print is in line to a small beat on profit, with revenue near the RMB13.4-13.8bn bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 2026 profit beat (adj NI +50%) was sold because of the volume guide. In Q1 2026 (adj NI +5.2%, volume +13.2%) the stock drifted 3-4% lower (https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/2939526/zto-express-cayman-zto-down-4-3-since-last-earnings-report-can-it-rebound). On this name, profit beats have not been rewarded on their own.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer profits are public, but ZTO's consensus EPS growth of about +10% sits well below peers' +28% to +79%. Part of that gap is a base effect: ZTO's Q3 2025 did not collapse the way peers' did. If the market had priced a peer-like recovery, consensus would sit nearer RMB3.0bn+ and the stock would not have de-rated since July.
findings.independence: Shares the Huachuang note with finding 1. Independent: YTO Q3 report summary (https://wap.eastmoney.com/a/202610213902797224.html, 2026-10-21); the State Post Bureau series via Huxiu (https://m.huxiu.com/article/4899303.html, 2026-10-21): Jan-Sep revenue +7.2% against volume +4.3%. The ZTO Q2 figures come from its own release. Peer-to-ZTO transmission is a proxy.

findings.finding: Diesel prices rose through 2026 on the Middle East conflict: six domestic price adjustments, mostly up, including a capped September hike (S&P Global, 2026-09-11), and Chinese diesel FOB rose about 13% from July to August. On the Q2 call ZTO management flagged higher fuel prices and expanding social-insurance requirements as cost pressures. That is a line-haul unit-cost headwind for Q3 and the Q4 outlook, against the 3.0% line-haul unit-cost decline in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior ZTO print was found where unit cost alone moved the stock. Unit-cost declines are routinely cited in releases.
findings.why_not_priced: Management flagged it, and peers still grew profit strongly through Q3, so it is largely absorbed. If it were material and unpriced, peers' Q3 per-parcel profit would have fallen; instead YTO's rose 24%.
findings.independence: Company flag on the Q2 call (https://www.ainvest.com/news/zto-sold-guidance-cut-quarter-proves-price-war-2608/ snippet; https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/zto-express-cayman-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-18/). Diesel series: https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/international/2026/10/01/887351.htm. Macro-to-company proxy.

findings.finding: ZTO bought back US$740m of stock in H1 2026 (52% of 2025 adj NI, against a framework of at least 50% for dividends plus buybacks) and had US$1.36bn left on the March 2026-March 2028 program. Previews note late-October buybacks. A raised return or a fresh dividend at the print would support the stock, and continued buying supports the tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The March 2026 print announcing a US$1.5bn buyback rose about 9% (https://www.itiger.com/news/2620825450).
findings.why_not_priced: The program is known. Only an increase or a new dividend would be new, and no evidence of either was found, so this is small.

findings.finding: Q4 pricing is supported by regulation. At a State Post Bureau symposium on 22-23 October, companies were told to continue anti-involution, keep delivery fees stable and stop headquarters pushing costs onto networks. From 12 October YTO, STO and others raised prices in Shandong, then Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Henan. September price floors were also raised (at least 0.1 yuan per piece in Jiangsu, 0.15 in Anhui). This gives management room to guide to stable or rising Q4 ASP on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In 2025, price-recovery news lifted ZTO pre-market (+1.4% on August pricing data, https://www.itiger.com/news/2568259079). The anti-involution shift from Q3 2025 underlies the 2026 ASP gains.
findings.why_not_priced: Sector-wide and public. What is not public is ZTO's own Q4 ASP commentary. The headquarters cost-absorption instruction cuts slightly the other way (an HQ margin cost). If fully priced, the stock would not trade at a 9x sector P/E with a de-rating since July.
findings.independence: Huachuang note (2026-11-03) also expects stable prices. Huxiu, 2026-11-04 (https://m.huxiu.com/article/4903037.html): on 28 October ZTO set a direct-dispatch-fee floor of at least 25%, below STO's and YTO's, so its network cost burden is lighter. Sector-level proxy.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 adjusted net income was reportedly flattered by a one-time RMB344m tax refund (Ainvest commentary, snippet only; not checked against the release). Ex-refund, Q2 adj NI was about RMB2.74bn, so a Q3 figure near the RMB2.78bn consensus would look like a quarter-on-quarter step down from the headline RMB3.09bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None found specific to one-offs on ZTO.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus likely already excludes it. It matters only for the headline quarter-on-quarter optics. It is a one-off below the operating line with no path to guidance, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: None. Single AI-generated commentary source; the page returned 403, so only the snippet was read.

findings.finding: Expectations are low going in. Spot is $20.72, against $24.00 on 2026-07-27, 19.9% below the 52-week high and 9.9% above the low. Realised vol is 16.9% and sector P/E about 9x 2026. Sell-side is still Buy-leaning, with a $27 average target in July. That leaves room for a relief rally if the volume guide holds at 6-10%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Reactions to recent prints ranged from -5.8% (Q2 2025) to +9% (Q4 2025). The pattern is sizeable moves on the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning, not information. A de-rated stock with high days-to-cover reacts more on a 'less bad' guide. If the market expected a guide hold, the stock would not have fallen 14% since July.
findings.independence: Sealed baseline tape (pct_from_52w_low 9.86). Short-interest days-to-cover of about 11 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/zto/short-interest/).

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with, and the 20-day run-up is flat. The negative volume finding agrees with the de-rating since July (partly priced), while the profit and pricing positives cut against it. The net is near zero, consistent with the 4.67% implied move carrying no directional lean.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar disputed: CN¥3.43 vs 3.10): profit finding capped from +0.8 to +0.5.

Lesson 1 (verified profit beat is not a reaction; ZTO sold the Q2 +50% NI print on the volume guide): this supports keeping the volume/guide finding at -1.2 and the profit finding small. p_up held at 48.
Lesson 2 (one-off below operating income): Q2 tax-refund optics trimmed from -0.2 to -0.15.
Lesson 7: short interest checked. About 2% of shares, not crowded, but days-to-cover about 11, so the negative was not enlarged. Positioning finding left at +0.4.
Lesson 5: the peer-derived findings are labelled as proxies in independence; their sizes were already small, so no further cut.
